PAYMENT SERVICE ROLLBACK RUNBOOK
PAYMENT SERVICE ROLLBACK RUNBOOK

Last modified: 2025-11-03 | Owner: Platform Team | Category: RUNBOOK
------------------------------------------------------------

When to Roll Back:
Rollback is appropriate when a production deployment causes elevated
payment failures and the previous release is known to be healthy.

PROCEDURE
1. Confirm the incident commander has approved rollback.
2. Check the current deployment version in the release dashboard.
3. Select the previous production image from deployment history.
4. Roll back the application deployment.
5. Verify health checks.
6. Run a synthetic payment authorization test.
7. Confirm error rate returns to the normal operating range.
8. Record the rollback in the incident timeline.

DATABASE WARNING!!!
Do NOT automatically roll back database migrations.
If the release contains an irreversible migration, use the
migration-specific recovery procedure.
